subject.title: [Bug]: memsearch-summarize sub-session compaction fails with "No API provider registered for api: ollama" on 2026.7.1, while main-session compaction with the same provider succeeds

question: Should the current-main Ollama compaction fix first ship in the next mainline stable release, or be isolated and backported to a v2026.7.x patch release?
rationale: Current main passes the exact path, while the latest stable release remains affected; only release ownership can weigh the bounded memory-quality impact against backport risk.

options.title: Ship in next stable
options.body: Identify the fix SHA, confirm it remains covered on main, and document the next stable version as the first supported release.

options.title: Backport to v2026.7.x
options.body: Isolate the exact fix and its focused tests into a patch release after confirming it does not depend on broader post-release runtime refactors.

recommendation.title: Ship in next stable
recommendation.body: Identify the fix SHA, confirm it remains covered on main, and document the next stable version as the first supported release.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining question is release placement rather than runtime implementation, and the release history provides the strongest available ownership signal.
